resolutions.researcher_notes: NOT an existence/duplication concern — the pipeline is real, operating and correctly classified. The concern is a single unsupported VALUE. The sheet carries SegmentCost = 44,700,000,000 RMB with an empty [ref] and an empty SegmentCostYear. The only sourced investment figure for this segment is 436.48亿元 = 43,648,000,000 RMB (2014 NDRC 核准, 含外汇3.3亿美元), reported by 新华网 via 人民网 and by 中国新闻网 on 2014-06-04. The 44.7bn figure matches the GEM wiki's 'Finance: 44700 million RMB' field, so it is almost certainly a GEM-internal carry-over (uncitable per standing rule 1); its own wiki footnote resolves to a dead ndrc.gov.cn URL. Tier medium, independent=false: 新华网 and 中新网 republish ONE announcement. Note also that 436.48亿 is the approved TOTAL for the 1-trunk-5-branch scope of the 2014 approval, part of which (株洲－郴州支干线、邓州支线、新野支线) was later CANCELLED and part (长沙支线) re-approved as a separate project — so even the sourced figure is a 2014 approval-scope number, not an as-built cost. If the tracker wants an as-built segment cost, none is public. 中国新闻网's copy (https://www.chinanews.com/ny/2014/06-04/6243599.shtml) carries the identical text but is GB2312 and the verifier mis-decodes it (name_found false on a page that plainly names the segment) — a decoding false negative, not a bad source; it is not proposed here because it is the same origin as 人民网 anyway.

resolutions.researcher_notes: RELEVANCE RE-READ RESOLVED **and** the owed second source found. The carried ref (news.cn/world 2023-08-18) named nothing and was flagged 'unnamed'; it is live (200) and is kept, but it is no longer the evidence. PRIMARY, segment-naming and near-verbatim to the sheet string: MEE 环审〔2014〕16号 on 西气东输三线中段（中卫－吉安）— 「气源主要为中亚天然气，新疆煤制天然气作为补充」. The sheet's 'Natural gas in Central Asia, Xinjiang coal-based gas as a supplement' is a direct translation of that clause, so the value is confirmed at its origin. SECOND SOURCE: Oil & Gas Journal (2012) — a different publisher, a different language and a different document class (trade press vs Chinese regulator) — states WEP3 will 'mainly transport gas from the Central Asia pipeline, using incremental production in the Tarim basin and coal gas in Xinjiang to supplement these supplies'. AGGREGATE-VS-SEGMENT DISCLOSURE: OGJ names only the WEP3 SYSTEM. I judge that legitimate for THIS cell because FuelSource is a supply-chain property of the whole WEP3 (one gas stream entering at Horgos from Central Asia Line C and moving through west→middle→east sections), not a segment-specific spec like length or pressure — the segment-naming MEE text carries the row identity, OGJ corroborates the substance. Recorded rather than assumed, per the aggregate-vs-segment rule. OGJ adds one detail the sheet omits (Tarim incremental production as a second supplement) — not staged, since the sheet string matches the regulator's wording.
